pdf.name: PDF Tools
pdf.description: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs in your browser.

image.name: Image Tools
image.description: Convert, compress and resize images in your browser.

audio.name: Audio Tools
audio.description: Convert, trim and compress audio in your browser.

merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose.

split-pdf.name: Split PDF
split-pdf.description: Extract page ranges into separate PDFs.

compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF
compress-pdf.description: Shrink a PDF by re-rendering pages at a lower quality.

images-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
images-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG and PNG images into one PDF.

pdf-to-images.name: PDF to Images
pdf-to-images.description: Export every page as a PNG or JPG.

rotate-pdf.name: Rotate PDF
rotate-pdf.description: Rotate all pages or just the ones you pick.

reorder-pdf-pages.name: Reorder PDF Pages
reorder-pdf-pages.description: Put pages in a new order.

convert-image.name: Convert Image
convert-image.description: Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC, right in your browser.

heic-to-jpg.name: HEIC to JPG
heic-to-jpg.description: Turn iPhone HEIC photos into JPG files without uploading them.

compress-image.name: Compress Image
compress-image.description: Make photos smaller while keeping them sharp.

resize-image.name: Resize Image
resize-image.description: Scale images to an exact width or height.

faq.a1: No. Processing happens entirely inside your browser. We have no server that could receive your files.
faq.a2: Yes. The free plan handles up to 3 files per run, 25 MB each, 10 runs a day. Pro removes those limits with a one-time purchase.
faq.a3: The extension works offline. The website needs one load, then the tool itself runs without a connection.
